_comment: Edit this file on the machine that has IDEA. Replace every "column" value with the REAL column name in your IDEA table/query. Delete field entries you don't have data for — their schema default (or empty string) is used instead. Run: python idea_to_catalog.py --mapping mapping.json --out catalog.json

source.db_url: REPLACE-ME — SQLAlchemy URL, e.g. sqlite:///C:/idea/catalog.db  |  access(ODBC): access+pyodbc://@?odbc_connect=DRIVER%3D%7BMicrosoft+Access+Driver+(*.mdb,+*.accdb)%7D%3BDBQ%3DC%3A%5Cidea%5Ccatalog.accdb  |  mssql+pyodbc://user:pass@host/DBName?driver=ODBC+Driver+17+for+SQL+Server

subjects._comment: Free-text subjects column, one row's subjects separated by `split`. thesaurus:"match" looks each term up in ../../data/thesaurus_photo_archive.json to fill the HE/EN pair; unmatched terms are kept as {he: term, en: ""}.

people._comment: Optional. Two ways to fill the identification table. (1) inline: a single column holding all names, split into rows. (2) join: a separate people table keyed by the record id — provide its own mapping. Set mode to "none" to skip.

join.query: SELECT record_id, full_name, position_he, position_en FROM people
join.name: full_name
